overview_description.description:
Doha Bank provides domestic and international banking services for individuals, commercial, corporate and institutional clients through four business groups – Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, International Banking and Treasury & Investments.

Doha Bank has established overseas branches in Kuwait, Dubai (UAE), Abu Dhabi (UAE), Mumbai and Kochi (India) as well as representative offices in Japan, China, Singapore, Hong Kong, South Africa, South Korea, Australia, Turkey, the United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, Bangladesh and Sharjah (UAE).

product.name: Personal Banking Accounts
product.description: Current, savings, call, payroll, Al Dana savings, and fixed-deposit accounts for individuals to manage daily finances and save funds.

product.name: Personal Loans
product.description: Unsecured and salary-linked financing for individual customers, including monthly-rental, top-up, deposit-backed, and retiree loan options.

product.name: Housing Loans
product.description: Property financing for ready-made, under-construction, freehold, and leasehold properties, including balance transfers and rental-income loans.

product.name: Credit Cards
product.description: Mastercard and co-branded credit cards offering payment facilities, installment plans, rewards, travel benefits, and merchant discounts.

product.name: Debit and Prepaid Cards
product.description: Himyan and Mastercard debit or prepaid cards for account access, cash withdrawals, and domestic or international purchases.

product.name: Digital and Alternative Banking Channels
product.description: Online and mobile banking, SMS and telephone banking, WhatsApp support, kiosks, interactive teller machines, ATMs, and digital wallets.
